profile.headline: at HiArc
profile.summary: Accomplished Technical Manager with over 20 years of experience in building scalable, secure applications and leading cross-functional teams. Adept at cloud migration, API security, and implementing CI/CD pipelines. Seeking to leverage expertise in micro-services to drive innovation and efficiency in a forward-thinking organization.

positions.title: Technical Manager
positions.description:
•	Developed the Lender Application, a highly secure and scalable AWS first solution providing forecasting and risk management solutions for lenders within the CoStar Suite application.
•	Provided Technical Guidance, coordination, collaboration and coaching across 6 different development teams.
•	Responsible for Assessing Security Risks and Vulnerabilities to the segmented encryption strategy and least privileged security policy that secures client data in a cloud environment.
•	Championed the cloud migration of the credit calculation engine from on premises solution to AWS EC2 solution to its current AWS ECS Fargate solution to improve cost, reliability, and scalability.
•	Pioneered a new data processing architecture that improved reliability while reducing data processing frequency and duration.  
•	Responsible for Application Programming Interfaces (API) security requirements, promoting best practices.
•	Developed a Continuous Integration and Release Process strategy for information technology quality assurance (QA).
•	Generated reports, charts, tables, and dashboards to alert, monitor, and measure performance using Datadog, Google Analytics, Kibana, Pendo and internal reporting systems.
•	Advocated for internal tooling to diagnose and troubleshoot production issues that comply with security policy. 
•	Advising Chief Technical Officer (CTO), Software Architect, Vice Presidents, Directors and other Technical Managers on current capabilities and application of latest IT technology to the Lender application.
•	Responsible for mitigation of issues reported by static code analysis tools such as Veracode, Checkmarks and Prisma.
•	Responsible for architectural diagrams as part of SOC certification process.
•	Hiring Manager conducted phone screenings and interviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Dynamodb · React.js · NoSQL · ASP.NET · Technology Management

positions.title: Software Architect and Lead Developer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop the Patriot Multi-Echelon Training (P-MET) application, a 3-dimensional training simulation in C# using the XNA framework
•	Serve as Lead Developer for 10 software engineers by providing leadership skills and technical direction to ensure project goals are met 
•	Serve as Software Architect for 15 engineers by providing the vision and structure needed to ensure that customer concepts are realized 
•	Serve as the Database Administrator and Database Designer by developing all stored procedures, defining all table definitions, and coordinating the deployment and backup of the database
•	Serve as the Tool Smith by providing the support and integration of CruiseControl.NET, nUnit, 3DS Max, Resharper, GhostDoc, Sandcastle, Visual Studio, Max.Net, Redgate .Net Developer, Redgate SQL Developer, Clearcase, and SVN

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed the DARTS application, a data processing and analysis tool written in C++ using MFC
o	The DARTS application is used to process, translate, & unpack data from multiple CPU architectures that vary by bit count (24, 32, & 64) and bit order (i.e. endian) across different systems
•	Served as the Lead Developer of the core data processing engine within the DARTS program
•	Trained and guided developers, who were transitioning from FORTRAN to C++/MFC
•	Coordinated and developed the interface specifications that controlled how data is represented across all systems within the Patriot Missile Defense System

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and Developed the LCSS and RLDC applications, a suite of desktop applications written in C++ using MFC
o	The LCSS and RLDC applications are used to perform diagnostics and collect data with the RLRIU, a real-time embedded system
•	Provided field support and training of soldiers and engineers both domestically and internationally

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
•	Provided development and validation support to Mitsubishi Heavy Industries in Nagoya Japan
•	Provided technical support for the AWACS and Patriot interoperability validation efforts in Hamamatsu and Wajima Japan

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained the real-time embedded RLRIU system in Ada
•	Senior engineer responsible for the Remote Launch Capability, Data Reduction, Data Collection, and Diagnostic Support Software within the RLRIU system
•	Provided direct customer support in both test and fielded environments
